_what: DATA for prove-seven-views.mjs: where a computer's sign-up and sign-in are (trillion-rust src/native_entry/computer/signup.rs, src/account/sign_in/pages.rs), the records the web shell's list road keeps (trillion-apps web/src/workspace/list-records.ts over records-door.ts), the list screen's address, and the views the proof switches through with what the page shows for each. Every selector names the file it was read from.

sign_up._from: trillion-rust src/account/sign_in/pages.rs sign_up(): the page posts /sign-up/options then /sign-up/finish, whose answer is { address }; the account is then reached under /a/<address>.

sign_in._from: trillion-rust src/native_entry/computer/signup.rs: the person signs in at /a/<address>/sign-in after sign-up; the same page script presses navigator.credentials.get and goes to data-next or /.

records._from: trillion-apps web/src/workspace/records-door.ts (writeRecords, readRecord, listRecordsFrom) and list-records.ts (makeList: list:<id> of type list; putRows: record:<row_type>:<row>; saveView: list-view:<list>:<view> { list_id, view, order }).

list_screen._from: trillion-apps web/src/workspace/lists-screen.tsx: the list a /lists/<list> address names, opened on ?view=<id> when named, else the open saved view's display.as.
